review.source: The assembled source and all five packed clips were inspected on dark and light backgrounds. The selected 42 poses preserve Sylvie’s adult human face, deep-brown skin, voluminous silver-white curls, orange headband and white/navy/orange Fleur Noire uniform. The final pose in the primary dribble-run strip touched the canvas edge and is recorded as excluded; all selected poses are complete, distinct and readable. Each loop has the required idle6, idle-ball4, dribble10, run11 and dribble-run11 action order. No fixed-side trait or directional mark is specified, so body mirroring preserves her identity.
